result.instructions: Tools for Acuity Scheduling, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What appointments do I have tomorrow? Group them by calendar."; "Find the next three free 60-minute slots for a consultation next week."; "Reschedule Jane Smith's Thursday appointment to Friday at the same time.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Acuity Scheduling data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run acuity_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run acuity_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run acuity_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. acuity_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: acuity_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List appointments scheduled on the account. For bulk contact/parent lists, use view: contacts to return only id, firstName, lastName, email, phone and datetime, without forms/formsText. Contacts view or an explicit offset returns {appointments, pagination}; follow pagination.nextOffset with identical filters until null. Pages fit below the tool output cap and can contain fewer than max rows. Offsets are connector-managed by fetching a prefix (Acuity has no documented native offset); at 10,000 appointments per filter/date window, narrow minDate/maxDate and restart at 0. Appointments may change between calls; deduplicate by id. Default full view without offset preserves the original array response. Acuity REST: GET /appointments.

max.description: Max appointments to return (default 100). Paginated output may return fewer to fit the output cap; follow nextOffset.

offset.description: Zero-based connector offset; enables paginated output. Start at 0, then use pagination.nextOffset with the same filters. At 10,000 rows, narrow the date range.

view.description: full (default): appointment details. contacts: only id, firstName, lastName, email, phone and datetime, in a compact paginated response; excludes intake forms and notes.

excludeForms.description: Omit forms and formsText, including from full-view results. Automatically true for contacts view. Uses Acuity's excludeForms parameter.

minDate.description: Only appointments on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime).

maxDate.description: Only appointments on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime).

calendarID.description: Filter to a specific calendar id.

appointmentTypeID.description: Filter to a specific appointment type id.

canceled.description: If true, return canceled appointments (default false).

direction.description: Sort order by datetime. Acuity defaults to DESC; paginated calls use DESC unless specified.

tools.name: acuity_get_appointment
tools.title: Get appointment
tools.description: Get a single appointment by its id. Acuity REST: GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: acuity_list_appointment_types
tools.title: List appointment types
tools.description: List the account's appointment types (services and classes), including price, duration and calendars. Acuity REST: GET /appointment-types.

includeDeleted.description: If true, also include deleted/inactive appointment types.

tools.name: acuity_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List the account's calendars (staff/resources appointments can be booked on). Acuity REST: GET /calendars.

tools.name: acuity_availability_dates
tools.title: Get available dates
tools.description: List dates in a month that have availability for an appointment type. Acuity REST: GET /availability/dates.

appointmentTypeID.description: Appointment type id to check availability for (required).

month.description: Month to check, formatted YYYY-MM, e.g. '2026-08'.

calendarID.description: Restrict to a specific calendar id.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the returned dates, e.g. 'America/New_York'.

tools.name: acuity_availability_times
tools.title: Get available times
tools.description: List available time slots on a given date for an appointment type. Acuity REST: GET /availability/times.

appointmentTypeID.description: Appointment type id to check availability for (required).

date.description: Date to check, formatted YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2026-08-15'.

calendarID.description: Restrict to a specific calendar id.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the returned times, e.g. 'America/New_York'.

tools.name: acuity_availability_classes
tools.title: Get available classes
tools.description: List existing group class time slots in a month. To offer a new session use acuity_offer_class (Enterprise credentials required); booking an attendee does not offer a new class. Acuity REST: GET /availability/classes.

month.description: Month to check, formatted YYYY-MM, e.g. '2026-08'.

includeUnavailable.description: If true, also include full/unavailable class times.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the returned times, e.g. 'America/New_York'.

tools.name: acuity_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List clients on the account, optionally filtered by a search string (name/email/phone). Acuity REST: GET /clients.

search.description: Optional search string to match client name, email, or phone.

tools.name: acuity_list_forms
tools.title: List intake forms
tools.description: List the account's custom intake forms and their fields. Acuity REST: GET /forms.

tools.name: acuity_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the account's products / packages / gift certificates for sale. Acuity REST: GET /products.

tools.name: acuity_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List store orders (product / package / gift-certificate purchases). Acuity REST: GET /orders.

tools.name: acuity_list_blocks
tools.title: List blocked-off times
tools.description: List blocked-off (unavailable) time ranges on the account's calendars. Acuity REST: GET /blocks.

minDate.description: Only blocks on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime).

maxDate.description: Only blocks on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime).

calendarID.description: Filter to a specific calendar id.

tools.name: acuity_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List the appointment labels (colored tags) defined on the account. Acuity REST: GET /labels.

tools.name: acuity_get_me
tools.title: Get account info
tools.description: Get the authenticated Acuity account's profile (name, email, timezone, plan, currency). Acuity REST: GET /me.

tools.name: acuity_inspect_class
tools.title: Check class or camp capabilities
tools.description: Read this connected account's appointment type, calendar and one month of all class offerings (including private/full sessions). Identifies ordinary classes versus series and whether this connection is configured for Enterprise class creation. Use before adding a camp date. Series edits remain unsupported because existing attendees' enrollment effects are unverified. This inspects actual account data and makes no writes, bookings or plan changes.

tools.name: acuity_offer_class
tools.title: Offer a new group class session
tools.description: Offer one NEW session of an existing group class appointment type. Requires Acuity Enterprise API access: reconnect with the Scheduling Instance ID, Enterprise API key and optional Enterprise ID field filled. First call previews; set confirm=true only after the user approves the calendar, date and time. Creates an offering, not an attendee booking. Existing offerings are rejected, and series are excluded to avoid changing enrolled clients' schedules. Dates/times use the calendar's timezone. Acuity Enterprise: POST /information/availability/classes, with no update id.

appointmentTypeID.description: Existing group class appointment type ID.

calendarID.description: Calendar on which to offer the new session.

date.description: New session date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the calendar timezone.

time.description: New session start, HH:MM (24-hour), in the calendar timezone.

confirm.description: False previews without writing. True creates this exact new session after user approval.

annotations.title: Offer a new group class session

tools.name: acuity_create_appointment
tools.title: Create appointment
tools.description: CREATES a new appointment (books a client into an existing time slot). To offer an additional group class session use acuity_offer_class; this tool books attendees. This MODIFIES the calendar and, unless suppressed, may send confirmation emails. Acuity REST: POST /appointments.

datetime.description: Start time in ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. '2026-08-15T14:00:00-0400' (required).

calendarID.description: Calendar id to book on (defaults to an available one).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the datetime, e.g. 'America/New_York'.

notes.description: Notes to attach to the appointment.

fields.description: Intake form field answers, each { id, value }.

admin.description: If true, book as admin — bypasses availability checks and required-form enforcement. Default false.

noEmail.description: If true, suppress client/owner confirmation emails.

tools.name: acuity_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel appointment
tools.description: CANCELS an existing appointment. This MODIFIES the calendar and, unless suppressed, may send cancellation emails. Acuity REST: PUT /appointments/{id}/cancel.

admin.description: If true, cancel as admin (bypasses client cancellation restrictions).

tools.name: acuity_reschedule_appointment
tools.title: Reschedule appointment
tools.description: RESCHEDULES an existing appointment to a new time (and optionally a new calendar). This MODIFIES the calendar and, unless suppressed, may send update emails. Acuity REST: PUT /appointments/{id}/reschedule.

datetime.description: New start time in ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. '2026-08-16T10:00:00-0400' (required).

calendarID.description: Move the appointment to this calendar id.

admin.description: If true, reschedule as admin (bypasses availability checks).

tools.name: acuity_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: CREATES a new client record in the account's client list. This ADDS data to the account. Acuity REST: POST /clients.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Acuity Scheduling
prompts.description: What you can do with Acuity Scheduling here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_open_times_for_an_appointment_type
prompts.title: Find open times for an appointment type
prompts.description: The AI checks which dates in a month have availability and lists the open time slots on a day for one appointment type. You get the next open slots without opening the calendar.

prompts.name: review_the_appointments_for_a_day_or_week
prompts.title: Review the appointments for a day or week
prompts.description: The AI lists appointments with filters and can open a single appointment. It groups them by calendar or client and shows time, type and who booked.

prompts.name: book_a_client_and_add_them_if_new
prompts.title: Book a client, and add them if new
prompts.description: The AI finds an open slot, checks the client list for the person, creates the client if needed and books the appointment. Acuity may send the confirmation email.

prompts.name: reschedule_or_cancel_an_appointment
prompts.title: Reschedule or cancel an appointment
prompts.description: The AI finds the appointment by client and date, then moves it to a new time or cancels it. Acuity may send an update or cancellation email to the client.

prompts.name: see_which_group_classes_have_space
prompts.title: See which group classes have space
prompts.description: The AI lists the group class time slots in a month for class-type appointment types. You see which classes are scheduled and when.
